title: MIDI
howTip: The MIDI files of your projects and your MIDI folders (Settings > Folders). A key also keeps its relative; a tempo, half and double. Drag a file straight into Live.
indexing: Spool is reading your MIDI files in the background.
none: No MIDI file found. Add a MIDI folder in the settings.
dragTip: Drag it into Live or a folder.

player.soundTip: The sound the MIDI plays with. Auto picks from the file: piano for chords, bass for basslines, drums for beats (and channel 10), synth for melodies. Piano, strings and brass are real recorded instruments.
player.loopTip: Play the clip again and again, on its bars
player.empty: This MIDI file holds no note.
player.unreadable: This MIDI file could not be read.
player.inApp: Listening to MIDI files works in the app.
player.transposeTip: In semitones (drums stay as they are). A click on the value puts the original key back.

dragChanged: Drag it into Live as you hear it here, transposed and at the tempo chosen.

source.label: Where to look
source.clipsTip: The MIDI clips written in your Live projects: chords, basslines, melodies and beats, each clip once even when copied into ten versions.

searchClips: Find a track, a clip, a project...
clipsReading: Reading the MIDI clips of your projects: they show here when the scan ends.
clipsNone: No MIDI clip found in your projects yet. Start a scan from the left bar.
usesTip: The projects this clip is in
